elucidating the mechanisms by which geminiviridae cause disease in plants and the molecular interactions between viral and host proteins that mediate viral movement.

the geminivirus MP BL1 is sufficient to induce disease symptoms in transgenic plants.
BL1 is the movement protein for geminivirids.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BL1 is a novel cell wall-localized protein that functions in geminivirus movement and that BL1 and the BR1 protein are not interchangeable in viral movement.

The main takeaway from our work is that
BL1 is the first viral protein shown to be able to induce disease symptoms when expressed alone in transgenic plants.
the expression of the BL1 protein alone in transgenic plants can produce symptoms of viral disease, which suggests that BL1 may be the major determinant of viral movement.
the BL1 movement protein alone is sufficient to induce disease symptoms in tobacco, suggesting a role in viral cell-to-cell movement.
